w: Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals for the abhishek murti of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Then Swamishri attended the BAPS Centenary Celebration assembly. He was welcomed by thousands of flag-waving devotees. In his blessings Swamishri appreciated and blessed the devotees of the New York mandal. The Council Member of New York City Mr Hiram Monserrate sent a letter of citation to honour Swamishri. At 8.00 pm Swamishri departed from New York mandir and travelled to East Brunswick to preside over and bless the 2½-day National Leadership Seminar for leading BAPS volunteers. The shibir theme was ‘Sanstha, Siddhant and Satpurush’.

The highlight of this evening assembly’s programme was a drama based on the story of Nachiketa written by Aksharvatsal Swami. Swamishri praised the theme and drama performance by youths of Ahmedabad. In his blessings Swamishri elaborated upon the glory of God and his all-doership.

ds.t: Doubts on the path of surrender
w: A sadhu, speaking about his favourite subject for katha, said, "Mostly I greatly enjoy speaking about surrender (sharanagati)." Finally he said, "I used to speak about surrender, but even though we have truly come to the refuge, the arguments of the intellect keep troubling us; you could even call it a lack of faith. So whatever we say does not happen as it should. Please bless us that it can happen."
When he made this prayer, Swamishri was swallowing a pill with milk. The pill was still in his mouth when Swamishri began to speak.

Swamishri said, "We have set out on this path. This is the spiritual path. Thorns and pebbles may well come on it, but if we have kept the thought of surrender firm, there will be no problem. The mind's thoughts are just like that, but if we think of the glory, nothing else will enter the mind. Even devotees have faced obstacles, but they did not touch their minds."
Another sadhu said, "Please bless us that we believe whatever you say is true, even if however much intellect or experience says otherwise."

Swamishri said, "The Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato are both the essence of all the scriptures. So keep reflecting on their words. In them, answers also come. Shriji Maharaj himself has said that this Vachanamrut is the essence of the four Vedas, the six Shastras and the eighteen Puranas. And God and the Sant are the givers of liberation. Since we have taken hold of this path, by the grace of God it is this that will take us across. All the essence is contained in the Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato. When we do katha, we take support from other scriptures, but it is the knowledge of the Vachanamrut that we give, isn't it! Shriji Maharaj also studied all the scriptures and then gave the Vachanamrut. So if we see a flaw in his words, what will happen then? There is no flaw in them at all. Shriji Maharaj extracted the essence and gave it to us, so keep faith and carry on with the work."
In this way Swamishri keeps showing the direction of the spiritual path again and again to the seekers walking on it.

Speaking of his favourite subject in katha, a sant said, "Most of all, I greatly enjoy talking about surrender." Finally he said, "I used to talk about surrender, but even though we have truly come to the refuge, the arguments of the intellect keep troubling us; you could even call it a lack of faith. So whatever we say does not happen as it should. Please bless us so that it can happen."
When he made this prayer, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was swallowing a tablet with milk. The tablet was in his mouth, and Swamishri began to speak.

Swamishri said, "We have set out on this path. This is the spiritual path. Thorns and pebbles may come on it, but if the thought of surrender is kept firm, there is no problem. The thoughts of the mind are like that, but if we think of the glory, nothing else enters the mind. Even devotees have faced obstacles, but they did not touch their minds."
Another sant said, "Please bless us so that we believe whatever you say is true, even if however much intellect or experience says otherwise."

Swamishri said, "The Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato are both the essence of all scriptures. So keep thinking over their words. The solutions are also found in them. Shriji Maharaj has said that this Vachanamrut is the essence of the four Vedas, the six Shastras and the eighteen Puranas. And Bhagwan and the Sant bring liberation. Since we have taken hold of this path, by Bhagwan's grace that alone will take us across. Everything is summed up in the Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato. When we give katha, we take support from other scriptures, but we are only giving the knowledge of the Vachanamrut, aren't we! Shriji Maharaj too studied all the scriptures and then gave the Vachanamrut. So if we see a flaw in his words, what then? There is no flaw in them at all. Shriji Maharaj has drawn out the essence and given it, so keep trust and carry on with the work."
In this way, Swamishri keeps showing the direction of the spiritual path again and again to the sadhaks walking on it.
Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj woke from his rest, Anantnayandas Swami asked, "Swami! What kind of sadhus and devotees do you like?"
"Simple hearted."
In this one word Swamishri told what he likes. Hearing it, the message "Behaving simply is good, O mind, behaving simply is good..." became firm
in everyone's heart.
Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the assembly, a question and answer session began with Swamishri to receive his farewell message.
Question: "As satsangis, as members of a family and as individuals, what should we do?"

Swamishri said, "We should see divinity in everyone. If we see divinity, we progress and reach the top level, and the reason is unity. We must keep unity in the home, in the family, in the extended family, in satsang and then in the whole BAPS family. We have to reach that far. If there is no sense of divinity, it is hard to keep unity. Maharaj said many times, 'When we see worldly feelings towards what is divine, we immediately become sad.'"
Question: "What is the one main thing to keep in mind to maintain unity?"

Swamishri said, "There is one key point: do not look at whether the other person keeps unity or not. We should keep unity. If you think, 'I will keep it if the other person keeps it,' the quarrel will never end, and there will be ruin and destruction. Instead, think: What should I do? What thoughts should I have? What should I say? Do not look at whether the other person does it or not. The feeling of unity should come from our side."
Today, during Mahant Swami Maharaj's meal darshan, the world famous sarangi player Ustad Kamal Sabri, son of Padma Vibhushan Ustad Sabri Khan, had come specially to sanctify his art.

Every year he comes to America and Toronto to give sarangi performances. This time, when he came to America, he phoned Gunsagardas Swami to meet him. Gunsagardas Swami told him, "I am enjoying the darshan and company of Guru Mahant Swami Maharaj."

Shri Kamal Sabri is a devout Muslim, but he is impressed by our mandirs and sadhus. As soon as he heard Swamishri's name, he expressed an intense wish to have Swamishri's darshan and, if possible, to present his art as well... He said, "Whether there is a stage or not, I just want to sanctify my art, that is all..."
Now, during Swamishri's meal darshan, it became possible to arrange for his wish to be fulfilled.
Bowing down to Swamishri, he began to play the notes of the sarangi with deep feeling...

Gunsagardas Swami took Shri Kamal for his meal. While eating, he said, "As I was playing the sarangi, I was looking at Swamishri when our eyes met, and I could not bear the radiance that came from his eyes. Tears began to flow from my eyes... His divinity, his purity, his personality touched me."
Yesterday a white businessman and today a Muslim master of art were drawn to Swamishri. Truly, Swamishri belongs to everyone.

yt: Tapomurti Shri Nilkanth Varni Murti Pratishtha
